comments.author: Melodic-Chemistry127
comments.body: I'm using local models from the Qwen 3.6 series with Q4 quantization and only reach for online models for planning or when Qwen is just not good enough, which is somewhat rare. I'm coding on my Mac and the model runs on my PC on the same network.

replies.author: count023
replies.body: how much ram dos that fit on?

replies.author: Melodic-Chemistry127
replies.body: I have 4080 Super with 16GB VRAM. It's a tight fit, sometimes I have to run the Q3 version when the context is too big, but it is very serviceable. I have 64 GB system RAM, but I don't like offloading to system RAM because it absolutely kills the speed.

replies.author: odragora
replies.body:
Could you please tell more about your setup? All Q4 quants of Qwen 3.6 I saw are bigger than 16 GB, and context eats VRAM too.

Also, do you use llama.cpp, LM Studio, or something else? What config you have for 16 Gb? Are you running it on a Windows machine?

replies.author: Melodic-Chemistry127
replies.body: IQ4\_NL from Unsloth, for example, is 15 GB, then there are plenty Q4s that are 16 GB and some that are 14. I'm running on Windows through Unsloth Studio.
